HOME SCIENCE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #5
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: HOME SCIENCE
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   B. A chemical reaction forming ash
   C. Heating until a solid melts
   D. Movement of water only across a membrane

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Kitchen Layouts and Equipment? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Kitchen Layouts and Equipment.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Kitchen Layouts and Equipment.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Kitchen Layouts and Equipment.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Kitchen Layouts and Equipment.

3. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Burning crop residue every week
   B. Overgrazing continuously
   C. Removing all vegetation
   D. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Safety in the Home? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Safety in the Home.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Safety in the Home.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Safety in the Home.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Safety in the Home.

5. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only water vapour
   B. Nitrogen gas only
   C. Only carbon dioxide
   D. Glucose and oxygen

6. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. joule (J)
   B. pascal (Pa)
   C. newton (N)
   D. watt (W)

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Housing the Family? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Housing the Family.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Housing the Family.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Housing the Family.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Housing the Family.

8. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Petrol fires have no fuel
   B. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   C. Water removes heat too quickly
   D. Water always increases oxygen

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Overview of Home Science? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Overview of Home Science.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Overview of Home Science.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Overview of Home Science.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Overview of Home Science.

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Methods of Cooking? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Methods of Cooking.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Methods of Cooking.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Methods of Cooking.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Methods of Cooking.

11. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   B. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   C. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   D. A mixture always has a fixed melting point

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Hygiene During Puberty 2.2 Safety in the Home 2.3 Housing the Family 2.4 Cleanin? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Hygiene During Puberty 2.2 Safety in the Home 2.3 Housing the Family 2.4 Cleanin.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Hygiene During Puberty 2.2 Safety in the Home 2.3 Housing the Family 2.4 Cleanin.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Hygiene During Puberty 2.2 Safety in the Home 2.3 Housing the Family 2.4 Cleanin.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Hygiene During Puberty 2.2 Safety in the Home 2.3 Housing the Family 2.4 Cleanin.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Kitchen Layouts and Equipment and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Food Hygiene and Safety and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Nutritive Value of Foods 1.5 Methods of Cooking 2.0 Home Management 2.1 Hygiene  and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Nutritive Value of Foods and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
